title: OrgAccess: A Benchmark for Role-Based Access Control in Organization Scale LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking role-based access control (RBAC) and hierarchical rule-following in LLMs. While it mentions 'Ethical AI Guidelines' as one of its 40 tested permission types, this is included as a logical constraint for data access rather than a component for evaluating religion, morals, or ethics themselves.
